independence_declaration.statement: qa-verifier, session 294c05d1-af75-4757-8b9d-b12f959d14bb, task T-DG7-REV-QA-R4. At the start I checked the assignment's sha256 (cb818b831016eb8934c5a3fbfe2de112cfc8131ac9f85a8dc124621ad1fabb90). In this run I wrote no product implementation, no test in the candidate, no register row, ADR, handover text, repair or delivery decision, and I changed no candidate file. My probes (the F-DG7-940 mutants, the A18 driver with --keep, the release-notes revert, a known-limitations regeneration) ran in a disposable clone under $TMPDIR at 471072d6, which I removed at the end. Their scripts are kept as evidence outside the candidate. The implementer roles listed wrote the product, tools, guides, register and the round-3 repairs (AN-P7G, BE-R8); the orchestrator froze the candidate and regenerated the handover texts. I formed this verdict before reading any other reviewer's round-4 record, and I have not read them. Their run commits (8d1ba28af domain, 44fe6cfed code-security) appeared during my run, and their round-4 evidence directories showed up as file names in git status. I opened neither, and the commits change no file outside docs/delivery/runs, reviews and test-evidence. My protocol-audit runs scanned the live repository; I used only the audit's counts and the implementation-handback hits I cite.

checks_run.procedure: Confirm the frozen candidate before and after the review: recompute the candidate id in a fresh clone at the source commit and in the repository tree, run --diff against the committed manifest, and list what changed between the freeze commit and HEAD.
checks_run.command: git rev-parse HEAD; git clone . $TMPDIR/review-qa && git checkout 471072d6 && node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG7; node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG7 --diff docs/delivery/candidates/DG7/d91f7152950ed711.manifest.json; git log/diff a76c2aed4..HEAD (start 03:56Z and end 06:03Z)
checks_run.environment: Repository tree and disposable clone $TMPDIR/review-qa at 471072d6; Node 24.21.0 (/opt/nvm/versions/node/v24.21.0/bin first on PATH); pnpm 10.33.0; 4 vCPU shared with two concurrent reviews.
checks_run.expected: sha256:d91f7152...0e59 with 3155 files from the clone and from the tree; --diff matches true with nothing added, removed or changed; nothing outside review records and evidence changes during the run.
checks_run.actual: Clone at 471072d6 and tree both print sha256:d91f7152950ed7119b412db0135836c53a3f01e95300af32c86db367f0712e59 with 3155 files, exit 0, at the start and at the end. In the tree, --diff reports matches true with 0 added, removed and changed, exit 0. One invocation exited 1, and it was my mistake: I first ran --diff inside the clone at 471072d6, where the round-4 manifest does not exist yet (the freeze commit adds it). That run is in 01-candidate-and-historical.log; it is invalid and was replaced by the tree run. HEAD was a76c2aed4 (the freeze commit) at the start, not the source commit. The freeze commit changes only the three round-4 assignments, the manifest and stages.json, none of which is a candidate entry, so I proceeded, as the candidate id binds this review. At the end HEAD was 44fe6cfed: the two other reviewers' run commits, with nothing changed outside docs/delivery/runs, reviews and test-evidence (empty diff stat). The candidate still recomputes to d91f7152. Assignment discrepancies, disclosed: (1) it says 'round: 7', but tools/gates/lib/rules.mjs requires rec.round to equal the round directory, so I used 4; (2) it says to mirror docs/delivery/reviews/DG5/round-4/qa-verifier.json, which does not exist (that directory holds only release-auditor.json), so I mirrored my DG7 round-3 record and the schema; (3) its finding owner list omits delivery-orchestrator, which the findings schema allows; see F-DG7-970.

checks_run.procedure: Run the gate validator in historical mode for every approved gate DG6..DG1 on the current tree, then the same on the source commit as a control. Also run --reconcile and --stage DG7 to locate the cause.
checks_run.command: node tools/gates/validate.mjs --historical --stage DG6 (then DG5..DG1); in the clone at 471072d6: --historical --stage DG6 and DG1; node tools/gates/validate.mjs --reconcile; node tools/gates/validate.mjs --stage DG7; git show a76c2aed4 -- docs/delivery/stages.json
checks_run.environment: Repository tree at HEAD a76c2aed4 (freeze commit); clone at 471072d6 for the control; Node 24.21.0.
checks_run.expected: The assignment: '--historical --stage DG6 must pass (and DG5...DG1)'. Every historical run prints PASS and exits 0.
checks_run.actual: FAIL. On the tree, DG6, DG5, DG4, DG3, DG2 and DG1 each print 'FAIL gate DGx (historical) (1 problem) - stages.json: DG7 illegal transition REVIEWING -> REVIEWING' and exit 1. --reconcile fails with the same single problem, exit 1. --stage DG7 shows it plus the expected 'gate DG7: file not found', exit 1. Control: in the clone at the source commit 471072d6, whose stages.json ends with the round-3 REVIEWING entry, --historical DG6 and DG1 print PASS and exit 0. Cause: the freeze commit a76c2aed4 appended {REVIEWING, 2026-11-16T03:55:37Z, 'Round 4 frozen on sha256:d91f7152 (D-276)'} directly after the round-3 REVIEWING. The FIXING state of the round-3 repairs is missing, and TRANSITIONS allows REVIEWING -> FIXING | VERIFYING | BLOCKED only. The approved gates themselves are intact. The orchestrator's pre-freeze historical run (prefreeze-r4/historical.log, exit 0) predates the freeze commit, which is why it passed. stages.json is excluded from the candidate, so this does not change d91f7152, but the gate validator cannot pass until it is repaired. Raised as F-DG7-970 (Medium, owner delivery-orchestrator).

All four round-3 findings are verified closed: F-DG7-920 and F-DG7-960 (a fresh audit gives C3 = 7, all seven handbacks named in the register, 'seven' in the release notes and known-limitations, and a revert-to-fail on the release notes); F-DG7-921 (the register cites DO-D8B's real-restart run, and my own drill on this candidate shows postmaster 4261 stopping and 5001 starting inside D9); F-DG7-940 (M4 is killed by the new export-scope test; an extra M6 is killed too). The product passes everything I ran: unit 3042+2199+259, integration 4696 (475 files), tool suites 466/189/66/39/29, product e2e 286+286 plus the keyboard spec 2/2, root acceptance 288 with a loopback-only connection log, offline drill 10/10, A18 drill D0-D11 plus harness 10/10, A19 R1-R9, and a K11 re-drill. Skips and residuals are explained per check. One new finding, F-DG7-970 (Medium, delivery record): the round-4 freeze commit appended REVIEWING after REVIEWING in DG7's stage history with no FIXING, so validate.mjs --historical (DG6..DG1), --reconcile and --stage DG7 all fail. The repair is in stages.json, outside the candidate, and does not change d91f7152. It must be repaired before the gate (D-192), so my verdict is FAIL.
